999008199.text:
ふう……とりあえず神聖国の使者ってことで
ベスティラの王様と王妃様に謁見はできそうだね

localizations.en: Whew... Well, at least we should be able to get an audience with the king and queen as envoys from Nova.

999008199.text:
なんかさっき街で聞いたけど、ここの王様は
気さくだから誰でも会ってくれるみたいだよ？

localizations.en: I heard in town earlier that the king here is really easygoing and will meet with anyone!

999008199.text: ええっ、ありがたい限り……！

そんな気のいい王様なら、事情を話したら
「九偉人図」も気前良く譲ってくれたりして

localizations.en: If he's that friendly, maybe he'll be generous enough to hand over the Portrait of the Nine once we explain the situation.

999008199.text:
よくぞ参った！
遠路遥々ご苦労だったな

localizations.en: Welcome! You've come a long way to reach us.

999008199.text: でっ……でっか……！

い、いかにも屈強な戦士ってカンジ……
なるほど、これは誰とでも会えるはずですわ

localizations.en: Talk about the picture of a mighty warrior... I can see why he's not worried about meeting just anyone.

999008199.text: 悪い人に襲われても、返り討ちにしちゃいそうだね……

localizations.en: If anyone tried attacking him, he'd probably beat them down without breaking a sweat...

999008199.text:
して、神聖国の使者よ！
我がベスティラに何用だ？

localizations.en: Now then, envoys of Nova! What brings you to my kingdom?

999008199.text:
あ、はい！　王様がかつてブラオールの商会から買った
「九偉人図」という絵を……

localizations.en: Ah, yes! It's about a painting called the Portrait of the Nine that you purchased from a merchant company in Braulle...

999008199.text:
ああ、あの絵か。
あれはいいものだ。作者の魂、情念が籠っている

localizations.en: Ah, that painting. A fine piece. The artist's soul and passion flow through every brushstroke.

999008199.text:
その、お気に入りの絵を、恐縮ですが
お譲りいただけないものかと……

localizations.en: I know it's a favorite of yours, and this is terribly presumptuous, but... would you consider parting with it?

999008199.text: あれは、王様がとーっても気に入ってるんだよ

localizations.en: That painting is one of the king's absolute favorites, you know.

999008199.text: 交渉できるようなものじゃないと思うけど

localizations.en: I don't think it's something he'd be willing to negotiate over.

999008199.text:
いやぁ、厚かましいのは百も承知ですが。
人の業といいますか、それでも欲しくてですね

localizations.en: I know it's audacious to even ask, but... well, human desire being what it is, we really do want it.

999008199.text:
いくらでしたら
お譲りいただけるでしょうか？

localizations.en: Would there be any price that might change your mind?

999008199.text: 金はいらん。代わりに、お前らの生き様を見せろ！

localizations.en: I don't want money. Instead, show me how you live!

999008199.text: 生き様……？

この世で最も大切なものは、金でも、命でもない。
生き様だ。どう生き、どう死ぬか……

localizations.en: The most precious thing in this world isn't gold or even life itself. It's how you live. How you fight, how you die...

999008199.text:
九偉人図、あれには描き手の生き様が込められている。
あれを欲するのなら、それ相応の生き様を見せてみろ！

localizations.en: That Portait of the Nine contains the artist's very way of life. If you want it, then show me a way of life worthy of claiming it!

999008199.text:
これは……獣人限定、ベスティラ武道会の告知？
全員一斉参加、最後まで残った者が勝利……

localizations.en: This is... an announcement for a martial arts tournament? Beastkin only, everyone participates at once, last one standing wins...

999008199.text:
優勝者にはベスティラ王が可能な範囲で
願いを１つ叶えてくれる……これに参加しろと？

localizations.en: The winner receives one wish from the king, within reason... You want us to enter this?

999008199.text:
そうだ。これに勝ち残り、「九偉人図」を望むがいい。
見たところお前も腕に覚えがあるのだろう？

localizations.en: Exactly. Win this tournament, then claim the Portrait of the Nine as your prize. You look like you can handle yourself in a fight.

999008199.text:
欲しいものがあるのならば、
お前の生き様で、掴み取ってみせるがいい！

localizations.en: If there's something you want, then seize it with your own way of life!

999008199.text:
ほーんと、この人ったら戦うの大好きだよねー。
戦うより楽しいこと、いっぱいあるのにねー？

localizations.en: He really does love fighting, doesn't he? There are so many more fun things to do than battle.

999008199.text: たとえば……そこの子猫ちゃん。お名前は？

localizations.en: Like... oh, you there, little kitten. What's your name?

999008199.text: い、イザナと申します

へえ、イザナちゃんっていうんだ。
うわぁめちゃくちゃかわいー、ちょっと耳触らせてー？

localizations.en: Izana? What a cute name. And you're absolutely adorable! Can I touch your ears?

999008199.text:
え、いや、耳は……その、アタシの生まれた村の掟で、
心に決めた人にしか触らせてはいけないんです！

localizations.en: Uh, well, my ears are... According to the customs of my village, I can only let someone I've pledged my heart to touch them!

999008199.text:
やだ、想い人がいるのー？
そう言われると余計欲しくなっちゃうなあ

localizations.en: Oh my, you have someone special? Now I want to touch them even more.

999008199.text:
はっはっは！
かようにわがままなところもかわいい奴よ！

localizations.en: Ha ha ha! Even her willfulness is adorable!

999008199.text: しかし、話は武道会が終わってからにしようではないか

localizations.en: But let's save such talk for after the tournament.

999008199.text: はいはい。ふふ、イザナちゃん。また後でね

localizations.en: All right, all right. Hehe, see you later, Izana.

999008199.text:
イザナちゃん……私いつも耳触っちゃってたけど……
ど、どうしよう、知らなかった！

localizations.en: Izana... I've been touching your ears all this time without knowing! Wh-what should I do?!

999008199.text: えへ。嘘だよー、うそうそ

localizations.en: Hehe. I was just kidding! Totally made that up.
